CONTENT
COMMENTS
BEST
MINE
NOTES
Read a description of a situation. Then write an e-mail about the situation. You will have 9 minutes. You should aim to write at 50-120 words. Write using complete sentences.
ITEM TEXT
You
live
on
the
second
floor
of
an
apartment
building
with
no
elevator
.
There
is
only
one
weak
light
bulb
at
the
entrance
of
the
building
and
there
is
no
light
by
the
stairs
.
Please
write
an
email
to
express
these
difficulties
.
You
should
write
between
80
and
120
words
.
Your
ideas
must
come
from
the
following
three
themes
:
1
.
Install
more
lights
;
2
.
Brighter
lights
;
3
.
Motion
sensing
lighting
.
